name: Db2 for i
tagline: The relational database built into IBM i (AS/400), integrated with the OS and object security.
description: Db2 for i is the database integrated into the IBM i operating system on Power servers, descended from the AS/400's built-in database. There is no separate database install: tables are OS objects, security is IBM i object authority, journaling provides recovery, and both RPG record-level access and SQL work on the same files. IBM ships enhancements through twice-yearly Technology Refreshes; IBM i 7.6 TR2 (July 2026) added BYOK encryption and new SQL services. Db2 Mirror offers synchronous active-active pairs. It is low-touch and very reliable for the many mid-market manufacturers, distributors and banks on IBM i, but is tied to that platform.

pricing.notes: Included with the IBM i licence; Db2 Mirror, Db2 Multisystem and some tooling are separately priced.

scale.notes: Scales up on Power hardware; Db2 Mirror pairs two nodes active-active and PowerHA geographic mirroring covers DR.

strengths: Integrated with the OS: no separate install, and very little DBA work
Object-level security and journaling built into the platform
Same data accessible via RPG record-level I/O and modern SQL
Db2 Mirror delivers synchronous active-active continuous availability
Regular Technology Refreshes add SQL services and security features
weaknesses: Only runs on IBM i on Power servers
Ageing RPG skills base and platform perception problems
Fewer third-party tools than mainstream databases
useCases: ERP and distribution systems on IBM i
Regional banking and insurance back ends
Exposing RPG business logic and data via SQL services and REST
